summary: Tested FASE 2 — Riepilogo Compensi Unificato. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass on /api/admin/persons/{user_id}/compensation-summary (coach 2026/2025, default year, athlete PRO, 404 invalid, 403 non-admin, 401 no auth, response shape). Frontend (Expo web static build): admin/coach/69adf76... shows the Riepilogo Compensi card ABOVE the Compensi card with all required data-testid (person-compensation-summary, summary-box-ras=€17.000,00, summary-box-fiscal-current=€10.200,00, ras-grand-total, fiscal-current-grand-total) and the orange '⚠️ Supera €5.000 (INPS)' badge. Year switcher works: clicking '‹' to 2025 keeps RAS=€17.000,00 (whole contract) and changes fiscal_current to €20.000,00 (coach 6800 + prior 13200 since 2025=earliest first year). admin/athlete/6a251c6f... mounts the same component inside the Compensi tab (after 'Gestisci Compensi e Quietanze') — has_compensation=true, but displays €0,00 + warning 'Date contratto incomplete' because the TestAlice record has no contract_start_date/contract_end_date. All matches the PRD.
action_items: Optional: nothing strictly broken. Initial test assertion was wrong on year=2025 — actual behavior (fiscal_current.grand_total = coach_total 6800 + prior_compensation 13200 = 20000 when is_first_year=True) is by design. Confirm with PO that exposing 'prior_compensation' inside fiscal_current.grand_total when is_first_year=True is the intended semantics — the UI shows the combined total but does not visually separate the 'pregresso' contribution from the year's contractual amount.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py L14025-14235 endpoint admin_person_compensation_summary: well-structured, multi-tenant society_id check, 403 vs 404 ordering correct. Uses both users and athletes collections to resolve dual-role; pregresso unified non doppio (max OR sum if both explicit). Solid.

L14143-14146 unified_prior logic: if both coach_prior>0 and athlete_prior>0 sums them; otherwise takes the max. Edge: a single record with prior=0 + the other with prior>0 returns the non-zero. Behavior documented inline. OK.
L14149-14150 earliest_first_year fallback when only one section exists: works for coach-only and athlete-only paths. OK.
Quartile rule logic in _calculate_proportional_amount_quartile (L13911-13975) already validated by 21 pre-existing unit tests in test_quartile_calculation.py (per main agent).
Frontend component PersonCompensationSummary correctly renders the warning 'Date contratto incomplete' when ras_calculable=false (TestAlice case). Good fallback UX.
server.py is 30946 lines — should be split into modules. Pre-existing technical debt, out of scope for this feature.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all required data-testid present, totals match PRD (€17.000,00 RAS, €10.200,00 Fiscal 2026, badge €5K), year toggle works on both coach and athlete pages

seed_data_creation: No seed needed — used existing coach 69adf7618a40c8115bda5c2d (Fede Rica) and athlete 6a251c6fd7734aedf9c18d94 (TestAlice).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoint GET /api/admin/persons/{id}/compensation-summary works for both user_id (coach) and athlete.id (atleta PRO). On the static Expo build (npx serve -s dist) the component PersonCompensationSummary is correctly bundled and visible on /admin/coach/[id] (above the 💰 Compensi card) and /admin/athlete/[id] (Compensi tab, after 'Gestisci Compensi e Quietanze'). Year toggle re-fetches via summary-year-prev/next. data-testid attributes available: person-compensation-summary, summary-box-ras, summary-box-fiscal-current, ras-grand-total, fiscal-current-grand-total, summary-year-prev, summary-year-next. Login on Expo web requires accepting cookie banner ('Solo necessari') BEFORE filling inputs and keyboard.type instead of fill for RN inputs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature implemented correctly. The only intermediate test failure was a wrong expectation in my own test code (I expected fiscal grand_total=6800 for year=2025 but the endpoint correctly sums coach 6800 + unified_prior 13200 because 2025 IS the contract's first year). Fixed by asserting on fiscal_year_current.coach_total instead.
